text: I had previously used a Best Buy filter refill that supposedly is for my Whirlpool refrigerator.  What a disappointment that was. This refill that is a Whirlpool replacement filter for my refrigerator is perfect. This is the one I'll purchase from now on.

This little ice machine is amazing.  My built in ice maker in my 8 year old fridge quit!  It was far too expensive to fix so I bought this.  I can fill my big ice bin in the freezer in 4 hours!  Even when my fridge was new the ice maker took days to make this much ice.  It will stick together when put in the freezer bin but I just shake it around and everything is fine.  I also really like the round cubes instead of the half moons that my icemaker made.  These seem to settle into the glasses easier.

There is only 1 size of ice cube for this machine, and the metal on the freezing coils looks like it is pulling back already. I have only used it twice. As far as the time it takes to make the ice, the machine is on point. I also don't like the fact that the inside doesn't have a cooling mechanism. All of the ice in the tray melts quickly and when you transfer it to the freezer it just turns into one big block. Not too bad for the price though.

Best purchase ever!! I was so tired of lugging bags of ice home, forgetting to bring it in to find a puddle in the car.  Makes fresh ice as needed and so easy to use.  Great sized "cubes"...fits into most water bottles. Never run out of ice again!!

I bought this for my father (retired Navy man) to sit beside his recliner while he watches tv. He suffers from dry mouth due to medications and CONSTANTLY needs ice! I couldn't have gotten him a more perfect gift! It's FAST and makes the perfect size pieces of ice for him! He RAVES about it every time I see or talk to him :)
I am an ice junky and this is a great addition to my kitchen!  The first set of ice is a little small but after that it works great!  Very happy with my ice Maker. I highly recommend it!
Love it !!!!!!

This thing is great. I named it "rocky" (cause it works like a champ). It makes ice within the first 5 minutes and keeps making ice until it runs out of water. I turn it on when I come home from work and by the time dinner is ready, I have ice for my drinks, and I have ice all night long. Turn it off when I go to bed and all of the ice melts back into the unit. On again the next day and "poof" ... more ice again. I find no need for an ice maker in my frig. With a power inverter and a jug of water on my boat, this thing would make ice all day long. I'd run out of beer before I run out of ice.

I bought this for my parents as a Christmas gift, since they just put a bar out in the garage and had no plumbing or anyway to make ice out there except to go in and out of the house.

This thing was the best value price wise, since they are all very similar and I didn't figure that ice cube size was something that would be worth paying extra for. This little machine is very basic control, just on and off no extra bells and whistles. It does work very well, you just fill up the reservoir with water and turn it on. Its got a lot of heft to it, and seems to be built well. It makes pretty good size ice cubes, and it makes them fairly quickly.

One observation. The first batch or two that it shoots out of the tray are a little smaller, and not as frozen. The thing is, by the second or third cycle the ice is very nice. Once this thing is going, just keep topping off the reservoir and you'll have ice for however long you want. It runs better and better the longer its on. My parents are very happy with this purchase. If they have a party, they fill it up and turn it on a few hours before hand and have ice for cocktails the whole time. Great buy.

The cup itself is surprisingly heavy, but given it's 18/8 construction, that makes sense.  Great quality and clear markings make this one of the best measuring cups on the market.  At least that I've encountered.  Bottom line, if you're in the market for a good measuring cup, this is for you!

This is an excellent pitcher for making coffee art. Since its become such a trend to serve cappuccino and lattes so beautifully decorated I've been determined to learn how to do it, I just love how it looks and the creativity of it. I bought myself a nice handheld frother and then realized it was going to take more than just that to be able to pull off my own art. I like the fact that this pitcher is stainless steel. Not only does that make me feel like it will last a long time but it also helps keep the milk warm longer. Since its metal it cannot go in the microwave but I find microwaving milk really changes the flavor and I don't care for it that way anyway. It can be washed in the dishwasher for easy cleanup. The spout is decently wide so layering is easy but it does make it more difficult to create more detailed or intricate designs. Since I'm barely conquering the leaf the larger mouth of the spout isn't affecting me yet. I'm loving how much better this works than the plastic measuring cup and spoon I was using before. It has the measurements clearly etched into the side and is easy to read. Its nice to know that I won't have to worry about the ink wearing off over the years making this unreadable. All in all it's a good quality, no frills froth pitcher and works exactly as I need it to. I'm sure I will have this for many years.

These water filters are NOT made in the USA. The product packaging clearly states that they are made for Whirlpool by 3M in Mexico. Close but no dice. Maybe the older version was made here in the states, but not anymore. This should be corrected in the product description as there are many of us that actually care about where something that filters our water is made. Minus 1 star.

Secondly, these are not packaged by Whirlpool and sealed in a way that they could not be tampered with. Everything else you buy these days is hermetically sealed in plastic so that you have to cut them with scissors to get them open - so why not these? Especially in the case of a product like this where you have to trust that what you're getting is genuinely New, and your family's health may count on it, I believe this is a substandard form or product packaging. Minus 1 star.

I previously used Whirlpool filter model 4396510.  I was hesitant to try these new filters based on the many negative reviews.  However, I decided to give it a chance.  Upon inspection of the EveryDrop filter, I noticed that the tip end design had changed, as noted by many other reviewers.  The two filter designs have the same tip.  However, the EveryDrop filter has a longer filter body which requires notches to be included in the body design near the tip to permit proper interfacing with the internals of the refrigerator.  This discussion is covered by other reviews, so I won't add to it here.  Another issue came to light as I read the packaging of the EveryDrop filter.  The package for the EveryDrop Filter 5 listed filter models EDR5RXD1 and EDR5RXD1B.  It also stated a the filters met particulate Class II (1-5 micron).  The EveryDrop website, and every other publication I found on a quick internet search, specifies particulate Class I (0.5-1 micron) for these filters.  I called Whirlpool customer service to find out why there was a difference in the listed particulate class.  The representative grabbed a filter off the shelf and read particulate Class I on the package.  Additional discussion uncovered that EDR5RXD1B is a Canadian model number and is not included in the description of the US packaging.  Also, the representative stated that the US filters are made in Mexico, but my filter listed Taiwan as the manufacturing location.  I have to conclude that Amazon sent to me
